title: Arkansas Revenue Replacement Architecture
subtitle: Two ledgers + Money Flow Map before choosing replacement taxes
core_question: Exactly what revenue must be replaced, who currently depends on it, and what replacement sources can grow with prosperity without simply shifting the same burden onto ordinary people through another tax?
philosophical_goal: Government increasingly earns revenue from the prosperity of the system rather than taxing the productive labor of individuals — and communities own enough productive capacity that growth itself helps finance the community.

individual_income_tax.anchor_note: FY2026 individual income tax PRIMARY BOUND at $3,859.1M (DFA generalRevenue202606.pdf)

property_tax.nature: Local infrastructure finance (schools, counties, cities, roads, police, fire, libraries, debt service, pensions)
property_tax.constitutional_hardness: Arkansas Constitution 25-mill Uniform Rate of Tax (URT) for schools — complete school property-tax retirement requires constitutional redesign or amendment after demonstrated replacement
property_tax.anchor_note: 2024–25 URT local foundation PRIMARY BOUND at $1,602,678,681 (BLR Funding Overview). Other property layers estimated separately.

residual_shock_absorber.name: Residual Wealth Contribution
residual_shock_absorber.role: Last-activated, self-retiring compulsory levy on substantial surplus wealth by beneficial economic ownership — never ordinary labor income; not the philosophical center of the system
residual_shock_absorber.rule: Exhaust prosperity engines first; if a gap remains, apply a universal high NW floor and include all economically owned wealth above it regardless of wrapper; illiquidity changes collection timing not liability; rate falls toward zero as engines grow
residual_shock_absorber.revised_by: CC-DEC-134 / UPD-147 — no-loopholes base + legal test

objective_lock: Move revenue away from taxing ordinary work and homeownership toward use, impact, depletion, visitor demand, luxury discretion, human-capital dependence, value capture, enterprise returns, prosperity-fund compounding, and external income — with Residual Wealth Contribution only as a self-retiring shock absorber on substantial surplus wealth by beneficial ownership, never ordinary labor income.

state_prosperity_revenue_ledger.incidence_rule: Every replacement source requires who-actually-pays analysis; income-tax repeal + large sales-tax hike is a regressivity risk, not a default.

community_prosperity_revenue_ledger.replaces: Property tax as local infrastructure finance
community_prosperity_revenue_ledger.governing_idea: A community should own enough productive capacity that growth itself helps finance the community.

tax_retirement_protocol.rule: Tax retirement is earned — not hoped.
tax_retirement_protocol.design: new prosperity revenue reaches threshold → reduce existing tax by equivalent safe amount → measure → repeat

stages.title: Build replacement revenue
stages.action: Stand up verified, recurring replacement streams with provenance

stages.title: Dedicate to Tax Retirement Fund
stages.action: Ring-fence replacement dollars so they cannot be silently spent elsewhere

stages.title: Safety-threshold automatic reduction
stages.action: When recurring replacement revenue meets a defined safety threshold, reduce the targeted tax by the safe equivalent

stages.title: Continue to zero
stages.action: Iterate until the targeted tax reaches zero without service collapse

local_up_constitutional_sequence.note: Research sequence sketch — not a legislative calendar commitment
local_up_constitutional_sequence.years_0_4: Build replacement-revenue pilots; reduce taxes that can be reduced statutorily
local_up_constitutional_sequence.years_4_8: Demonstrate community prosperity revenues and state equalization in multiple communities/counties
local_up_constitutional_sequence.years_8_12: Redesign school/local-government funding based on demonstrated replacements
local_up_constitutional_sequence.years_12_16: Constitutional amendment to retire remaining constitutionally required property-tax structure only after replacement has proved it can carry the load

replacement_source_tests.name: revenue_capacity
replacement_source_tests.question: Can it actually raise billions (or the local share required)?

replacement_source_tests.name: volatility
replacement_source_tests.question: Will it collapse in a recession or commodity crash?

replacement_source_tests.name: prosperity_alignment
replacement_source_tests.question: Does revenue rise when people/community prosperity rises?

replacement_source_tests.name: behavioral_distortion
replacement_source_tests.question: Does it discourage the productive activity we are trying to create?

first_research_slice_answers: Inventory every current Arkansas revenue source — state, county, city, school district — and current amount
Identify expenditures legally or constitutionally tied to particular revenue sources
Model potential replacement revenue sources without assuming they will be sufficient
Create a transition sequence where income/property taxes fall only after replacement revenue is demonstrably online
warning: Prosperity funds, community enterprises, and public investment returns are currently unmodeled revenue hypotheses — not replacement dollars. $3.859B income tax plus the statewide/local property-tax structure is an enormous replacement requirement.
